detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with permission to search `index=azure`.
• Install and configure: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Splunkbase 3110).
• Ensure `azure:monitor:activity` events are flowing (prerequisite UC: 4.2.58 when applicable).
• Map `azure` and field extractions per `docs/guides/aws.md`, `docs/guides/azure.md`, or `docs/guides/gcp.md` as appropriate.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable Azure Activity Log and Entra audit export to Event Hub or Storage; configure `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` modular inputs into `index=azure`. Tune exclusions for documented automation service principals.
Expected sourcetype: `azure:monitor:activity`. Validate with:
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="azure:monitor:activity" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="azure:monitor:activity" (operationName="Microsoft.Cdn/profiles/delete")
| table _time caller operationName resourceId status
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
The search scopes `azure:monitor:activity` in `index=azure` and applies `(operationName="Microsoft.Cdn/profiles/delete")` to surface `Azure Cdn profiles Delete`. Tune time range and alert threshold to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare result counts to the vendor console (CloudTrail Event history, Azure Activity Log, GCP Logs Explorer, or service-native UI). Spot-check `_time` and actor fields. Confirm CIM acceleration only after TA field mappings are verified.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_2_247_alert` with appropriate severity. Dashboard: Events list, timeline by operationName, table of caller and resourceId..
Failure modes: (1) empty results — verify TA input and index routing; (2) duplicate events — check S3/SQS duplication; (3) missing fields — upgrade `Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Splunkbase 3110)` and review `props.conf` aliases; (4) alert fatigue — add CMDB/allow-list exclusions documented in knownFalsePositives.
